patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Fever and pain behind my eyes
clinical.quoteLong: I'm visiting from Malaysia. Three days ago the fever hit all at once, then the headache behind my eyes and every bone started aching. I feel nauseated, but I haven't had any bleeding or bad stomach pain.
clinical.presentationShort: 34yo M visiting from Malaysia - 3 days high fever, severe retro-orbital headache, myalgia, nausea and faint macular rash. No warning-sign abdominal pain, persistent vomiting or bleeding.
clinical.presentationLong: 34-year-old male visitor from Malaysia with three days of abrupt high fever, severe retro-orbital headache, diffuse myalgia, nausea and a faint macular rash, without bleeding, severe abdominal pain or persistent vomiting.

diagnosis.primary: Suspected dengue fever without current warning signs
diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track -> CBC/hematocrit, dengue testing and hydration assessment; acetaminophen only, avoid NSAIDs, reassess carefully for warning signs
diagnosis.why: Abrupt fever, severe retro-orbital pain, myalgia and rash after time in a dengue-endemic region support dengue. He is stable and has no warning signs, so outpatient management after one laboratory resource category and hydration assessment is appropriate, with explicit return precautions.
diagnosis.redFlag: Watch for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, lethargy or fluid accumulation as the fever begins to fall.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style with smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines, warm detailed rendering and natural realistic proportions. Match the attached reference image's painterly style. Full-body wide shot, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, centered. Show the entire person, entire blue padded clinic chair and a small plain carry-on bag with all shoes and chair legs and generous margin. Subject: a Malaysian 34-year-old man in a lightweight travel shirt and chinos. Pose: sitting slumped, one hand shielding his eyes from light, the other resting on an aching thigh. Expression: feverish, photophobic and deeply achy. Visible signs: flushed face, tired eyes and only a very faint sparse pink macular rash on the forearms; the rash must be subtle and not visually dominant. No bleeding, bruising, dramatic spots, mosquito, text, logos, shadows, floor plane, watermark or border. Perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background.
